pages.text: The M15 corpus records 217 artifacts across eleven tiers. Artifacts track their bound owner UUID, refinement level, and awakened spirit. Awakening requires a bonded artifact refined to level 5 or higher and an owner in the Core Formation realm.
pages.title: Artifact Compendium

pages.text: Active abilities map to the technique effect registry. Synergy damage is applied through the LivingHurt multiplier and never bypasses the normal damage pipeline.
pages.title: Active Skills and Synergy

pages.text: realm_power_scale adjusts spiritual power cost, cooldown, and damage when an artifact is used beyond the wielder's realm.
pages.title: Realm-Gap Suppression

pages.text: Flying artifacts use FlyingAuthority for server-side eligibility checks and remain subject to no-fly regions and current artifact state.
pages.title: Flying Artifacts
